At η=0 one substitutes D=2 and ρ=(2Γ)^(1/d). Exact captured-root equality is an allowed subcase of the weak root lower bound.

Exact substitution at d=2 gives numerator 12/9 and denominator (61−24√2)/9. The weaker denominator is 29/9, giving 12/29. At d=1 the numerator is 3/2 and denominator 3, giving 1/2.
